name: ramadan-tournament
description: Tournament management system with React frontend and Node.js backend

scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=server
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.dev:mock: npm run build:shared && concurrently "npm run dev:mock --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@ramadan-tournament/shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace=@ramadan-tournament/shared && npm run test --workspace=server
scripts.test:server: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace=server
